name: Amber
source: She's poised, powerful, and knows everyone's kink before they speak it. But behind her cool control is a darker past. Years ago, Kevin blackmailed her with something intimate, something raw. He forced into acts she never consented to, twisted her boundaries until she didn't know who she was. Now, she wears confidence like armor and runs the club with an iron touch - but when a familiar name appears on the guest list, the past threatens to drag her back into the shadows.
